text:
li wei: hi team, quick onboarding snag. i can sign into redwood.okta.com but Google Workspace SSO keeps redirecting me to a personal gmail and then says 'Access denied: wrong account'. Okta Verify won't let me enroll either 03 'No enrollment token'. didn't get a 1Password invite either. first day nerves :) who should i nag?
it-support: welcome li! common cause is clicking the Google link then choosing a different account in the browser. try 1) open an incognito window, 2) sign into https://redwood.okta.com with li.wei@redwood.com, 3) follow the "Set up an authenticator app" flow to get the QR. also check spam for 1Password. can you paste the exact Google error if it repeats?
li wei: error exactly: `Access denied: Your account is not authorized for this application (google-workspace)` and browser opens my personal account chooser first. incognito didn't help, web shows "No QR available" when i try to enroll.
infra-admin: pinging on provisioning  checking SCIM logs. li, your user came in okay but you were missing the "core-employees" group due to a transient sync error. i've just added you and resent app assignments + 1Password (SSO) invite. i also forced a factor reset so a fresh QR should appear.
sam r.: fwiw when that happened to me i had to clear the "Accounts" list in Chrome's profile chooser. the browser sometimes caches the oauth selection. incognito or a clean profile fixes it. also watch out for enterprise privacy extensions that block popovers.
it-support: admin did the reset. after you sign out of any Google accounts in that browser, sign into redwood.okta.com and click "Set up an authenticator app". if you still see no QR, try a different browser or the desktop-to-phone flow: in Okta choose "I can't scan a QR" -> use TOTP code in Okta Verify.
li wei: new QR popped up after i signed out of personal accounts and opened Edge incognito. scanned, push came through and i approved it. Google Workspace SSO works now (used "Sign in with SSO" and it kept me on li.wei@redwood.com). 1Password invite arrived too but the invite page is showing a prompt to create a separate master password rather than "Sign in with Okta".
it-support: thanks for confirming Okta. for 1Password we use SSO-only invites. if you see a master password flow it means the invite link was a legacy one. i've reissued an SSO-enforced invite to li.wei@redwood.com. click the new link and choose "Sign in with Okta"; it will use your current Okta session. docs: https://redwood.example.com/internal/onboarding/1password-sso
li wei: reissued invite worked 1f3b6 clicked "Sign in with Okta" and it used my Okta login. quick Q: do i need to save recovery codes anywhere?
it-support: yes please save Okta recovery codes. we recommend storing them as a secure note in your 1Password personal vault. also enroll a backup factor (e.g., a second phone or YubiKey) if you plan to use hardware keys. see MFA docs: https://redwood.example.com/internal/security/mfa-policy
onboarding-bot: Welcome to Redwood, li! :wave: Checklist updated: Okta MFA enrolled, Google Workspace access confirmed, 1Password SSO accepted. Join #new-hires-intro at 4pm for intros.
li wei: huge thanks everyone, all green now. one tiny follow-up: when i turned on Okta Verify push it showed an option for "allow biometric unlock" 1f914 is that recommended?
it-support: biometrics are fine and convenient; enable if you want quicker approvals on-device. still keep recovery codes and a backup factor. if you want to register a YubiKey later, open a support ticket and we'll enable WebAuthn for your account.
li wei: perfect, enabling biometrics. thanks again :raised_hands:
